cohort: The study included 162 fetuses presenting with isolated or associated intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR) referred for prenatal testing.
finding: Chromosomal microarray analysis (CMA) demonstrated significant added value in the prenatal diagnosis of pathogenic copy number variations (CNVs) in fetuses with associated intrauterine growth restriction (IUGR), with an incremental yield of 6.1% over karyotyping, whereas no pathogenic CNVs were found in the isolated IUGR group.
